name: Snipe a Brainrot
desc:
Brainrots are everywhere. Your mission? Lock on, charge up your power, and blast them away!

🎯 Train Your Shot – Click to build power, then fire at goofy Brainrot targets.

🧠 Shoot Brainrots – Each hit earns you wins to unlock stronger weapons and upgrades.

🌍 Explore Zones – Progress through wacky environments packed with new Brainrot types.

🐾 Hatch Pets – Unlock loyal pets that boost your shooting power and help you climb the leaderboards.

🔄 Rebirth & Grow Stronger – Reset your progress for powerful multipliers and dominate faster.

🏆 Compete & Show Off – Prove you’re the ultimate Brainrot hunter!

🔥 EVERY WEEK = NEW UPDATE! 🔥

✨ Premium players get a +10% boost! 💪

🎉 Join the group to get a FREE OP PET! 🎯✨
